2607.08928.title: A Novel Parallel QCNN Architecture with Efficient Classical Simulability
2607.08928.paper_summary: This work presents a study of an implementation of a novel Quantum Convolutional Neural Network (QCNN) for binary classification of images from the Modified National Institute of Standards and Technology (MNIST) dataset. Using a novel architecture inspired by previous QCNN and classical convolutional neural network (CNN) implementations, we use a hierarchical partitioning approach to implement a QCNN circuit that can be approximated and simulated efficiently on a classical machine for a large problem. First, the original image is partitioned such that each process handles a smaller portion of the image, which is encoded into independent states. Then, these partitions merge and combine, resulting in states that contain information from both partitions while halving the number of processes. After repeating this until one process remains, we reduce the dimensionality of the state until a single qubit remains for measurement. Using this approach, we can use multiple processes in parallel to simulate a large QCNN program without the need for exponentially growing hardware requirements as the number of qubits increases. In our work, we use this scheme to train a 128-qubit model, which is impossible to run on any classical supercomputer without the novel architecture. We also explore the impact of this new model architecture on prediction accuracy by training it to perform binary classification on the MNIST dataset with a small number of qubits, and comparing it to a model without partitioning. Our initial findings show that partitioning images into smaller sub-images with this architecture does not degrade the model's performance and sometimes even improves it, likely because it reduces the Barren plateaus issue in the partitioning process.
2607.08928.paper_summary_zh: 這項工作提出了一項研究，實現了一種新穎的量子卷積神經網絡（QCNN）用於從修改過的國家標準與技術研究所（MNIST）數據集中進行二元分類的圖像。<lb/>利用受先前QCNN和經典卷積神經網絡（CNN）實現啟發的新架構，我們採用分層劃分方法來實現一個QCNN電路，該電路可以在經典機器上有效地進行近似和模擬，以應對大型問題。<lb/>首先，原始圖像被劃分，使得每個過程處理圖像的較小部分，這些部分被編碼為獨立狀態。<lb/>然後，這些劃分合併並結合，產生包含來自兩個劃分的信息的狀態，同時將過程數減半。<lb/>在重複這一過程直到只剩下一個過程後，我們減少狀態的維度，直到只剩下一個量子比特進行測量。<lb/>通過這種方法，我們可以並行使用多個過程來模擬大型QCNN程序，而不需要隨著量子比特數量增加而指數增長的硬體需求。<lb/>在我們的工作中，我們使用這一方案來訓練一個128量子比特的模型，這在沒有新穎架構的情況下無法在任何經典超級計算機上運行。<lb/>我們還通過訓練這個模型在MNIST數據集上進行二元分類，並將其與沒有劃分的模型進行比較，探討這種新模型架構對預測準確性的影響。<lb/>我們的初步發現顯示，使用這種架構將圖像劃分為較小的子圖像並不會降低模型的性能，有時甚至會改善性能，這可能是因為它減少了劃分過程中的Barren plateaus問題。
